catalogue_scope: All 56 chapter-fourteen dialogue paragraphs, two ending pages, the water-order choice and the battle briefing rendered in native Godot StoryView. Small 1008x700 layout and a native screenshot were checked. Catalogue routes start from earned chapter-thirteen outcomes; the battle win is supplied only to render postbattle pages.
earned_scope: Two chapter-thirteen earned saves, one per night-watch choice, entered the new battle and won using legal timed actions against production AI. Both builds and wards were used; a midbattle save was reloaded exactly. These are two specified diagnostic policies, not a continuous campaign or human playtest.
limitations: The aggregate authored Chinese body text remains below 100000 Han and a single route is shorter. No human balance, broad seed coverage, complete story ending or Steam acceptance has been established.
